question: Show me the top 5 highest rated shops that have absolutely zero bookings.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM shop_details sd JOIN reviews r ON r.shop_id = sd.id LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND b.id IS NULL GROUP BY sd.id, sd.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 5;
